# Shipyard
[mono][color=#897236]PURCHASE [/color] any shipyard console, ID card in hand[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]BERTH [/color] included with every hull[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]DEED [/color] on your ID card, reissued if lost[/mono]
[mono][color=#897236]UNDERWAY [/color] one civilian ship at a time[/mono]
The shipyard console is where you buy a ship and move its deed onto a new card if you lose the old one. Storing a ship you already own, and getting it back, live on the [textlink="Drydock" link="Drydock"] page.
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=cyan][bold]BUYING[/bold][/color] ──────────────────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
- Insert an ID card into a shipyard console and pick a hull from the list. - The listed price includes a [color=#a4885c][bold]berth[/bold][/color] of that hull's class, and the berth is created with the purchase. - A voucher ship is different: it carries no berth and cannot be stored.
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=lime][bold]YOUR SHIP[/bold][/color] ───────────────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
- Your deed lives on the ID card, not on the ship. Lose the card, insert a new one, and press [color=lime]Transfer deed[/color] on the Drydock tab to move the deed across. It comes off every other card the moment it lands on the new one. - Crew board through helm guest access rather than a copied deed. - You may have one civilian ship underway at a time. Buying another, or retrieving one, refuses while it is out.
[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#ffdd33][bold]PROVISIONS[/bold][/color] ──────────────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
Ships come equipped with the tools and supplies for one or more tasks in the Triad Sector: mining, research, medical, food service. Larger ones work best with a crew, so bring one aboard rather than flying alone.
